latest.name: Duck.ai — Private multi-model AI chat
latest.category: Hidden gems across any AI category
latest.short_verdict: A useful, often-overlooked no-signup way to compare several major AI models in one privacy-focused chat. Free use has an unpublished daily cap; Pakistan-specific free access was not independently tested.
latest.what_it_does: Duck.ai is a browser-based multi-model chat service. Its current free model picker lists Claude Haiku 5.5, Mistral Small 4, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.4 mini, gpt-oss-120b and Gemma 4 31B. It supports everyday questions, writing, summaries and conversations; selected models can also handle image or PDF uploads.
latest.why_try_it: It lets a user start without an account, choose among several model families, and ask a second model for another opinion. DuckDuckGo's Q3 2026 product update also documents model selection, reasoning controls, web search and image creation in the chat flow. This makes it a practical low-friction way to compare answers instead of relying on a single assistant.
latest.free_tier: Free access requires no account. The service has a daily usage limit, but DuckDuckGo does not publish a fixed message or token allowance. Image/PDF uploads are available only with supported models; free PDF uploads are limited to 15 pages. Spreadsheet uploads are not supported.
latest.limits: The free daily usage cap is real but its numeric size is unpublished and may depend on model/task cost. Not every model supports every attachment type. Optional DuckDuckGo subscription tiers increase usage limits and add advanced models; those upgrades are not part of this recommendation.
latest.signup_pakistan: No account or card is required for basic free Duck.ai use. Duck.ai can be opened in any browser. DuckDuckGo does not publish a country-by-country availability list for the free service, and a live Pakistan access test was not performed. Pakistan is not on DuckDuckGo's current official list of countries where its paid subscription is available; that does not establish that free Duck.ai is blocked.
latest.quality_evidence: Practical quality indicators rather than a claimed benchmark: the official free model list spans Anthropic, Mistral, OpenAI and open-weight models hosted by Tinfoil. DuckDuckGo's Q3 2026 changelog documents a Second Opinion feature that sends the same prompt to another model, plus model selection, reasoning controls, web search and image creation. No independent benchmark of Duck.ai as a wrapper was found; output quality depends on the selected underlying model.
latest.android_status: Official DuckDuckGo Private Browser Android app verified. Duck.ai is accessible through the browser; this is not a separate standalone Duck.ai app.
latest.optional_upgrade_note: Optional DuckDuckGo subscription access provides higher usage limits and additional models; the free chat remains usable without subscribing.
